test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Our chemistry teacher taught us how, through a chemical reaction, milk ________ into curd.
solution:
The correct answer is '**converts**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**converts**" means to change from one form to another.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the chemical reaction changes milk into curd, so "**converts**" is the most appropriate word.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** do not correctly convey the transformation process described.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Our chemistry teacher taught us how, through a chemical reaction, milk **converts**__ into curd."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "diverts"** is incorrect because it means to change direction, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 2: "progresses"** is incorrect because it means to move forward, which is not suitable for describing the conversion process.
 
• **Option 3: "happens"** is incorrect because it does not correctly convey the idea of transformation.
